textToSql.title: Text-to-SQL
textToSql.description: Ask questions in natural language and have Cortrix translate them into governed SQL against your structured stores — no hand-written queries.
textToSql.problemSolved: Analysts and Agents spend hours translating intent into SQL across unfamiliar schemas. Text-to-SQL closes that gap with schema-aware generation, guardrails, and query review before execution.
useCases: Let an Agent answer analytics questions over relational data without a SQL expert
Schema-aware query generation with managed PostgreSQL

auditLog.title: Audit Log
auditLog.description: A tamper-evident, enterprise-grade audit trail that records who did what, when, and from where — with full request context.
auditLog.problemSolved: CE operation logging captures successful operations, but compliance and security teams need source IP, user-agent, structured detail payloads, and failure reasons. The Ent audit log adds those columns and retention controls.
useCases: Meet SOC 2 / ISO 27001 audit requirements with a verifiable trail
Investigate security incidents with full request context (IP, user-agent, details)
Track denied and failed operations alongside successful ones

multiTenant.title: Multi-tenant
multiTenant.description: Switch between isolated tenants from a single deployment, each with its own namespaces, users, and policies.
multiTenant.problemSolved: Service providers and large organizations need hard isolation between teams or customers without running a deployment per tenant. Multi-tenant switching gives one control plane over many isolated tenants.
useCases: Serve multiple customers from one Cortrix Cloud deployment with strict isolation
Separate environments (dev / staging / prod) under one console
Per-tenant quotas, billing, and access policies
